grades.lower_bound_mechanism: none (finiteness of E merely asserted via false claim E subset of supp(a1); handwavy gap/rad-growth argument for false Lemma 2)
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: finite-state support tuples + backward induction (circular; rests on false Lemmas 2-5)
grades.notes: No characterization (C). Corollary 3's 'E subset of supp(a1)' is false by its own example (2 essential, 2 does not divide 15). Lemmas 2-4 are false: 20,40,50 are never divisible by essential prime 3, and a_{n+1} != a_n+30. Example omits a_9=45, so verification fails. Shift invariance mod L and backward induction only asserted, never proved.
